jess-cs: FYI customer reported Py SDK streaming stops ~10s after token refresh, yields partial JSON then iterator raises StopAsyncIteration without final event. Repro attached.
ingrid-support: Can you paste minimal repro + request_id please?
jess-cs: Repro code:
```py
async with client.stream("/v1/streams", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}) as s:
    async for chunk in s:
        print(chunk)
```
They run on pysdk==2.14.0.
devon-eng: Do we have request-id + server logs? suspect auth refresh thread racing with iterator close.
jess-cs: request_id=01GZQXABCDEF123 request_id_secondary=01GZQXABCDEF456 log snippet:
```
[2026-02-14T14:01:23Z] WARN auth: token refresh started for session=abc123
[2026-02-14T14:01:24Z] INFO sse: send event: {"type":"data","seq":42}
[2026-02-14T14:01:24Z] ERROR sse: client disconnected unexpectedly (err=broken pipe)
[2026-02-14T14:01:24Z] INFO auth: token rotated session=abc123
```
Observed that client printed partial JSON `{"text":"...` then stopped mid-object.
sam-runtime: This looks like the iterator's background task cancels read loop when auth rotate triggers re-open; if re-open overlaps you can drop final frame. We fixed a similar bug in the JS SDK last year.
devon-eng: Could be regression from 2.14.0 async iterator refactor (moved auth refresh into separate coroutine). Assigning eng-runtime to investigate. Can someone capture client-side debug log with ENV DEBUG=redwood:sdk?
ingrid-support: Escalate to eng-runtime and mark P1 for customer? Customer impacted in production, latency-sensitive.
devon-eng: I'll reproduce locally. Quick workaround: pin pysdk==2.13.1 or set auto_refresh=False and refresh token manually to avoid overlap.
jess-cs: Workaround confirmed by customer: pin to 2.13.1 — streaming stable for 30m. Customer wants fix and ETA.
devon-eng: Repro steps I'm using:
1. Run small script that refreshes token every 5s while streaming with 2 concurrent streams.
2. Observe that one stream prints final chunk then raises StopAsyncIteration immediately.
3. Server shows EOF exactly after auth rotate.
I'll push a test case to repo and link PR.
deploy-bot: Note: runtime team scheduled a canary deploy 2026-02-15 03:00 UTC
sam-runtime: Suggest adding handshake sequence number check on resume path and ensure we drain last frame before swapping sockets.
devon-eng: Next actions: (1) add unit/regression test, (2) bisect 2.14.0 commits to find offending change, (3) provide customer patch/backport or release 2.14.1 with fix. I'll update thread.
ingrid-support: Thanks. tagging @sam-runtime @devon-eng — customer notified with workaround.
